'''Minga''' was a genre of [[Music/Legends|music]] popular among youths during the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]] that was similar to [[b'ssa nuuvu]].<ref name="Rebel Bass">{{GamerCite|6|Rebel Bass}}</ref> The band [[The Emperor's New Clothes]] played in the minga genre.<ref name="Slugthrowers">{{SW|url=news/slugthrowers-part-2|series=Slugthrowers: An Overview of Popular Music and Musicians in a Galaxy Far, Far Away|text=Part 2|nolive=1}}</ref>
